text:
paul_finance: Heads-up 1 CardioAI disputed invoice CA-2026-07. They were charged $3,450 in burst/overage for Jul 14 and claim the traffic spike was driven by our partial outage.

zoe_sales: Context: CardioAI has a Dedicated commit (3xA100 equiv) $13,600/mo. On Jul 14 there was a surge and they used burst ~5.1 hours. Customer says this broke part of their ingestion pipeline.

dan_csm: CASE-14801: https://redwood.at/support/CASE-14801. Customer logs show elevated 5xxs between 10:12-15:30 UTC, many automatic retries. They want the overage removed or an SLA credit. :frowning:

ops_ryan: Infra check: we had a regional controller restart at 10:10 causing degraded routing and elevated latency. Measured partial degradation window = 3.2h. Root cause: controller config drift; PR with fix: https://github.com/redwood/controller/pull/6399.

billing-bot: Invoice CA-2026-07: Reserved commit = $13,600; Burst/overage = $3,450; SLA credit applied = $0; Total = $17,050.

paul_finance: SLA: "Partial degradation >=3h and <6h -> 18% credit of monthly Dedicated fee." 18% of $13,600 = $2,448. Options: (A) Apply SLA credit only -> invoice = $14,602 (keep overage), (B) Waive overage $3,450 + apply SLA credit $2,448 = total concession $5,898 -> invoice = $11,152. Waiving overage is a revenue write-off; need RevOps approval for option B.

marta_revops: what's the approval threshold?

zoe_sales: Customer explicitly asked for overage removal; they're in production and this week is critical for them. They'd accept SLA credit alone but prefer full removal plus a one-month complimentary burst buffer.

ops_ryan: Ops confirms the failure caused retry amplification. We'll add a one-line RCA to CASE-14801. Ops recommends waiving the overage.

marta_revops: I can approve up to $6k concessions with an ops RCA. Option B qualifies. Please add the RCA and I'll sign off.

paul_finance: @marta_revops please confirm and I'll issue corrected invoice/credit memo. Accounting note: waived_overage must be booked as one_time_writeoff and SLA credit as contractual credit.

marta_revops: Approved. Record: concession_type=one_time_writeoff; waived_overage=$3,450; sla_credit=$2,448; total_concession=$5,898. I'll log it in RevOps ledger.

paul_finance: Creating credit memo CM-2026-331 and corrected invoice CA-2026-07-C. Draft message to customer: "Thanks for flagging. We've applied a $5,898 concession (includes SLA credit) and issued corrected invoice CA-2026-07-C. We're sorry for the disruption; ops has implemented a fix and attached an RCA in CASE-14801. We've also added a 30-day complimentary burst buffer." Sharing for final sign-off.

zoe_sales: LGTM from sales. The buffer note is important.

dan_csm: I'll send to the customer and include the RCA link.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-331 created. Corrected invoice CA-2026-07-C issued.

dan_csm: Customer replied: "Thanks 1 we appreciate the concession and the buffer. Please keep us posted on any follow-up." :thumbsup:
